digest.component_or_area: LLM tracing and fallback model instrumentation
propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one rebar OTel span with zero-based order, provider-qualified model identity, and outcome from {returned, raised}, without duplication from instrument_all.
Candidate spans must parent to the single Agent model-request span via ambient OTel context nesting, verified by parent-span-id assertions.
Raised-span error reasons must be sanitized through sanitize_diagnostic (keyed under message) and contain no prompt, response, credential, endpoint secret, or unsanitized exception body.

The existing ordered FallbackExceptionGroup and S2-preserved bug-895c native-to-prompted fallback must remain unchanged; native attempt appears as raised span, prompted as returned span, with no _pai_structured control-flow modification.
Span emission or exporter failure while tracing is enabled must leave fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exception identical to tracing-off (best-effort exception swallow).
The base install without tracing extra imports must run with no span dependency error, and tracing disabled must produce identical result, usage, and exception behavior.
